title: You're not looking for the truth
hook: You're not looking for the truth. You're looking for people who agree with you.
caption: You're not looking for the truth — you're looking for agreement. Confirmation bias: believe, search for support, ignore the rest, feel more certain. Ask what evidence would change your mind, then go find it.
cta: Follow QuanTik for the psychology behind your money

thumb.footer: Simulated / sourced data • Educational, not advice
headline: YOU WANT
AGREEMENT,
NOT TRUTH.

scenes.say: You're not looking for the truth. You're looking for people who agree with you.
Confirmation bias: we notice, remember and believe what fits what we already think.
The loop: a belief, search for support, ignore the rest, feel even more certain.
Your feed spins that loop faster. Click on something, and it serves you more of it.
More information doesn't make you more right. It just makes you more sure.
Before a big decision, ask what evidence would change your mind. Then go find it.

takeaway: Before a big decision, ask what evidence would change your mind. Then go find it.
